lines: People all over the world have unique traditions to bring wealth in the New Year.
For example, in the southern United States, people eat a special dish called Hoppin’ John.
This dish is made with peas and other vegetables that look like coins and dollar bills.
People enjoy this dish to get lots of money in the coming year.
Another example is First Footing, the Scottish New Year’s tradition.
Scots believe that the first person to enter the house after midnight will bring good luck and wealth in the New Year.
The first-footer should be a tall, handsome male with dark hair.
He should be carrying symbolic gifts of coal, salt, and cake.
They represent warmth, wealth, and food respectively.
